title: Jig topology extension, profile 1
description: The block a Jig topology keeps in its Agent Spec Flow's metadata, under the key "jig" ("agentic_lab" before the rename, still read): what Agent Spec 26.3.1 has no construct for. Keys this profile defines are snake_case; values the engine reads as they are (a role's config and params, a wire's feedback, the topology's parameters) keep the engine's own names. See docs/FORMAT.md.

profile.description: This profile and its version. A document written before the rename says agentic-lab/topology@1, read as this one.

recommended_for.description: What the topology is meant for, in plain words: what it was designed for, not what a run has measured.

references.description: Research on what the topology does.

order.description: The drawn order: the roles left to right, the order every round runs in.

roles.description: Each role's engine and walls, keyed by the id of its AgentNode in the flow.

wires.description: What each wire carries beyond its data edge, keyed by the edge's id. A wire with nothing to add is {}.

provenance.description: Where each field of each signal type the roles emit comes from, as the engine declares it. Checked against the engine on read.

ways_back.description: Where the deciding role can send the work back, and on what condition. Each is drawn as an arc and written in the flow as a BranchingNode with a counter.

also.description: Wires back that start no round, drawn dotted under the boxes.

consults.description: Roles a role may call when it decides to, at most limit times a turn, each seeing only what the edge lists.

when.description: The stop condition, in short lines as drawn.

rounds.description: Rounds a run may take; 0 is no limit. The flow's round counter enforces it too.

kind.description: given: from you. measured: by the lab's own code. written: by a model. "measured or written": stamped on each signal, depending on the run. An object: a nested value whose own fields are declared.

label.description: The role's short name in the interface (Plan, Do, Check...).

sentence.description: What the role does here, in one sentence.

signals.description: The signal types the port accepts or emits.

engine.description: The engine that runs the role: a node type the lab registers (planning, execution, evaluation, critic, refinement, memory, or a custom one).

reads.description: The run inputs the role reads: "task", another input's name, or "*" for all. Absent: the engine's default (Plan, Do and Check read everything; the others nothing).

models.description: The models the role may run on, beyond the agent's llm_config: a brain's name (an ordered chain in the user's config), or a chain of its own. The llm_config holds the chain's first model, or the run's model for a brain.

brain.description: A brain's name: strong, fast, local, default, or one the user defines.

chain.description: Models tried in order, each "<entry>/<model>", the next only when one is unavailable.

config.description: The engine's settings, as the engine names them (maxIterations, toolPolicy, frequency, brain, skills, memory...).

params.description: The engine's own parameters (Decide's convergenceThreshold and maxRounds...).

fields.description: The fields the wire delivers; every other field is dropped on the wire. Absent: all fields.

feedback.description: The engine's declarative wire filter (whenSignal, where, asSignal, set, maxFires).

enabled.description: Present only to switch a wire off.

transform.description: A named transform the engine resolves.

filter.description: A named filter the engine resolves.

limit.description: Calls the caller may make in one turn.

sees.description: What the consulted role is shown: your task, the caller's question, the caller's whole turn so far, only its tool calls and their results, the lab's measured check run at that moment.

brain.description: Its own model, as the engine names it (provider, model, temperature, maxTokens). Absent: the run's.

instructions.description: Its system prompt. Absent: the lab's advisor prompt.
